Agent systems 4 products

Model routing, agent execution, and durable workflow state.

FlywheelTypeverified-inference platform and desktop clientFlywheel is a local AI workflow engine and native desktop app. It sends a task to a selected local or hosted model through an approved tool route, rechecks the result, and records witnessed receipts that can be reviewed or replayed.shipped · stable v0.3.10
ForumTypemulti-agent orchestration engineForum is a zero-dependency Python orchestration engine for teams of AI agents. It turns a request into dependent tasks, runs independent tasks in parallel through local commands or model APIs, pauses for human approval, resumes interrupted runs, and records a replayable ledger.shipped · stable v1.13.0
RelayTypepermission-gated coding agent and execution laneRelay runs a permission-gated coding agent across local models, subscription CLIs, APIs, gateways, and cloud endpoints, with failover, acceptance checks, resumable sessions, MCP access, and a hash-chained trajectory.active · active source 0.1.0; no GitHub release
MnemeTypedeterministic agent memory subsystemMneme is a zero-dependency SQLite memory store with CLI and MCP access for agent conversations and extracted facts. It stores session turns or imported source items, answers retrieval queries with deterministic BM25, vector, and recency ranking, and returns provenance, recall receipts, drift verdicts, replayable history views, and audited update or forgetting records.active · active source 0.2.0; latest tag v0.1.0

Evaluation and verification 4 products

Tests, receipts, provenance, and evidence-bounded conclusions.

CrucibleTypefalsifiable claim evaluation systemCrucible is a Python claim-testing engine. It breaks a thesis into claims with stated failure conditions, measures them against supplied evidence or checks, and returns MATCH, DRIFT, or UNVERIFIABLE with a record that can be recomputed.shipped · stable v1.2.0
EMETTypecross-implementation integrity witnessEMET verifies whether bytes reaching a model, reviewer, or pipeline still match their claimed source. It anchors and compares content, neutralizes embedded authority, audits drift, and mints portable closed-verdict receipts across four implementations.shipped · stable v1.2.0
Model Provenance ValidatorTypemodel provenance-envelope validatorModel Provenance Validator is a Python CLI that checks JSON records linking a model or release claim to its sources, retrieval dates, and publishable status. It redacts credential-like values from its output and can emit a Proof Surface packet, but it does not verify the underlying claim.shipped · alpha v0.1.1
Repo Proof IndexTypeevidence index and reviewer handoffRepo Proof Index is a Python CLI that scans proof packets, receipts, and contracts and builds a reviewer-facing index of each artifact's type, status, evidence summary, and source path. It validates known packet formats but does not decide whether the evidence is sufficient.shipped · alpha v0.1.1

Security and privacy 6 products

Authorized security engineering and privacy-preserving controls.

Proof SurfaceTypeauthorization and proof-packet libraryProof Surface is a zero-dependency Python library and telos-proof CLI that validates structured AI workflow, authorization, delegation, work, and witness records, builds evidence packets across eleven domains, and returns verdicts or advisory allow, deny, or needs-human decisions without authorizing or executing actions.active · active source 0.2.0; no release
PhantomTypehardware-identity privacy systemPhantom audits and changes reversible hardware-identity surfaces on owned or expressly authorized Windows and Linux systems, with backup and revert.shipped · stable v1.1.0
behavior-transform.ioTypelocal I/O wrapper and hook layerbehavior-transform.io is a local Python wrapper and hook layer for file reads and writes, subprocesses, HTTP fetches, operator input, and MCP traffic. It accepts an I/O request plus an operations or research mode and local text rules, then passes through or transforms the content and returns the requested result with hashes, substitution counts, return codes, or local audit artifacts.active · active public source; no tagged release
Accountable SurfaceTypecontrolled agent-action workbenchAccountable Surface is a Python runtime for executing bounded file, command, web, and browser actions under operator-supplied grants. It accepts an exact proposed action and target, an external authorization receipt, effector bounds, and an expected result; it returns an allow, deny, or needs-human outcome, performs only permitted effects, re-observes and verifies the result, rolls back reversible failures, and appends a hash-chained journal.active · active source 0.1.0; no release
Public Surface SweeperTypepublic release-surface auditorPublic Surface Sweeper is a Python CLI that checks a repository before publication for missing public files, unclear README handoff material, credential-like strings, release metadata, and proof-packet readiness. It is a release-hygiene check, not a full security scanner or certification.shipped · stable v0.1.1
Secret Redact IOTypesecret-aware I/O helper librarySecret Redact IO is a Python helper library that redacts file, fetch, write, and subprocess output while emitting hash-only receipts.shipped · stable v0.1.0

Developer infrastructure 5 products

Tools that make building, integrating, and releasing systems more reliable.

TelosTypelocal MCP workbenchTelos is a zero-dependency local workbench for creating, simulating, and replaying AI work. Its CLI and MCP servers expose workstation checks, creative simulations, research proofs, model and learning experiments, and browser or Windows automation, with a re-checkable receipt for each run.active · active source 0.2.0; latest tag v0.1.0
IndexTypeworkspace map and context systemIndex is a zero-dependency Python mapper for repositories and multi-repo workspaces. It reads manifests, imports, symbols, and local documentation, then writes offline wikis, dependency maps, context packets, and architecture checks with file-and-line evidence.shipped · beta 2.10.0 in source and PyPI
BuildLangTypesystems language and compiler toolchainBuildLang compiles a systems language with typed capability effects, sum and linear types, a production C backend, two-way C FFI, shader output, CLI and LSP tooling, and re-checkable build receipts.shipped · stable v1.2.0; non-C backends experimental
PlexusTypecapability mesh and toolchain wiring infrastructurePlexus is a local CLI and MCP discovery layer for agent toolchains. It reads each tool's declared inputs and outputs, finds compatible connections, and produces dependency graphs or runnable pipeline scripts; it probes registered Flywheel lanes only when explicitly requested.active · active source 0.2.0; no GitHub release
Agent Hook PackTyperepository hook toolkitAgent Hook Pack installs public-safe hooks for secret checks, branch guards, environment synchronization, and repository hygiene.shipped · stable v0.1.0

Graphics and media 10 products

Rendering, color, audio, image, and generative production systems.

Studio EngineTypeprocedural audiovisual engineStudio Engine is a local Python simulation and rendering engine that generates shader visuals, audio, and motion from one reusable scene description. It exposes a CLI and local HTTP API, can render deterministic PNG frames, and records hashes and a receipt for each generated scene.active · active pre-1.0 source 0.2.0; no release
Build ColorTypecolor-science library and workbenchBuild Color measures, converts, compares, and transforms digital color across perceptual spaces, HDR tone maps, appearance models, chromatic adaptation, spectral utilities, gamut mapping, ICC profiles, and LUTs, with an optional GUI.active · beta source 1.0.2; latest tag v1.0.1
Retro EngineTypeembedded browser visual and audiovisual studioRetro Engine is an embedded browser studio for images, drawing, GLSL, and audio traces. It applies pixelation, hardware palettes, ordered dithering, early-3D shading, CRT processing, and stackable effects, then exports images, patches, MIDI, relief or disc data, and Loom handoffs.active · active public application; no package release
Engine RevivalTypearchival/revival evidence platformEngine Revival is a Python tool for building, validating, auditing, indexing, and rendering public-safe metadata about historical engine revivals. It can also generate an out-of-tree BRender CMake harness from a public checkout.shipped · stable v0.1.0
BRender ArchivalTypeBRender restoration and build-test harnessBRender Archival rebuilds Argonaut BRender from its public MIT source, runs the restored code through a 21-stage native test ladder, captures reproducible renders, and packages the generated harness, README, captured test transcripts, checksums, and a release receipt without copying the upstream source.shipped · bounded milestone v0.1.1
Elder ENBTypeENB shader suiteElder ENB is an independently authored nine-stage ENBSeries 0.504 shader suite for Skyrim SE/AE, with five quality tiers, bounded cinematic effects, identity fallbacks, deterministic packaging, and an optional native frame-pulse runtime.active · prerelease v1.0.0-rc.5
Truth ENBTypeENB shader suiteTruth ENB is a from-scratch ENBSeries 0.504 shader suite for Skyrim SE/AE, with a computed physical atmosphere and sky, raymarched clouds, an aurora curtain, exposure and tone mapping, five quality tiers, and an optional native camera bridge.active · release-candidate source 1.0.0; tag v1.0.0-rc.1
ENB Runtime CoreTypeembedded runtime libraryENB Runtime Core is a C++23 embedded runtime library that identifies an already-loaded ENBSeries host, validates its SDK surface, queues callbacks outside callback context, coordinates save quiescence and reapplication, and gates a fail-closed Skyrim engine bridge.active · active source 0.1.0; no GitHub release
SkyrimBridgeTypeSKSE state, record, asset, ABI, and optional renderer systemSkyrimBridge is an SKSE plugin that exposes Skyrim live engine state, record editing surfaces, asset conversion, a versioned ABI, diagnostics, and shared-memory command channels to shaders and external tools, with an optional D3D11 rendering tier.active · prerelease v3.0.0-rc.1
RAWTypeSkyrim D3D11 rendering platformRAW is a D3D11 rendering platform for Skyrim SE that combines proxy-level pipeline ownership with SKSE-driven mid-frame effect dispatch, hot-reloadable HLSL, frame capture, GPU diagnostics, and a focused set of screen-space lighting and post-processing effects.active · active source 1.0.0; no public release

Research and education 3 products

Research intake, learning systems, publications, and teaching surfaces.

GatherTyperesearch intake and corpus systemGather extracts and crawls difficult research sources, including JavaScript-rendered pages, authenticated APIs, scholarly records, PDFs, OCR, audio, video, feeds, and local documents. It stores content-addressed corpora and attaches re-checkable provenance to every item.shipped · stable v1.6.1
LearnTypelearning and coursework systemLearn plans and re-checks learner-authored study sessions from declared objectives and recorded attempts, using spaced review, retrieval prompts, prerequisite gating, misconception tracking, prediction, and self-explanation. It separately runs course logistics while halting at graded work.shipped · published npm 1.6.0; no GitHub release
ChorusTypediscourse synthesis systemChorus turns a captured comment or thread corpus into weighted, clustered, re-checkable discourse digests that rank themes, surface dissent, and identify genuinely contested topics.active · active source 0.1.0; no PyPI or GitHub release
